tasks.task_name: Add codex configuration fields to workflow config
tasks.goal: The WorkflowConfig struct includes EnableCodexReviewers (bool, default true), CodexModel (string, default gpt-5.4), ReviewerTimeoutSeconds (int, default 300), and HoldoutTimeoutSeconds (int, default 300), all parsed from YAML config.

inputs.name: config_yaml
inputs.constraints: valid YAML with optional codex fields

outputs.name: config_struct
outputs.constraints: new fields populated with defaults when absent

acceptance: WorkflowConfig has field EnableCodexReviewers of type bool with yaml tag enable_codex_reviewers
WorkflowConfig has field CodexModel of type string with yaml tag codex_model
WorkflowConfig has field ReviewerTimeoutSeconds of type int with yaml tag reviewer_timeout_seconds
WorkflowConfig has field HoldoutTimeoutSeconds of type int with yaml tag holdout_timeout_seconds
DefaultConfig() returns EnableCodexReviewers=true, CodexModel=gpt-5.4, ReviewerTimeoutSeconds=300, HoldoutTimeoutSeconds=300
Parsing YAML with enable_codex_reviewers: false produces EnableCodexReviewers=false
Existing config tests continue to pass (go test ./internal/specworkflow/ -run TestConfig)

depends_on.reason: First task, modifies config only with no external dependencies

constraints: Must not break existing config loading
Use yaml struct tags consistent with existing fields

tasks.task_name: Extend team configuration with codex reviewer and holdout agents
tasks.goal: DefaultTeamConfig returns 12 agents (8 claude reviewers + 4 codex reviewers) when codex is enabled, 8 agents when disabled, with provider field on each agent and validation rejecting codex on non-reviewer non-holdout roles.

outputs.name: updated_team_config
outputs.constraints: 8 or 12 agents depending on codex flag

outputs.name: validation_result
outputs.constraints: non-nil if codex on non-reviewer role

acceptance: DefaultTeamConfig(enableCodex=true) returns 12 agents with reviewer-clarity-claude, reviewer-clarity-codex, etc.
DefaultTeamConfig(enableCodex=false) returns 8 agents with reviewer-*-claude names only
Each codex reviewer agent has Provider field set to codex
Each claude reviewer agent has Provider field set to claude
Non-reviewer agents (discovery, drafter, reviser, judge) have no provider suffix
ValidateTeamConfig rejects codex provider on judge role with error containing codex provider only supported for reviewer role
ValidateTeamConfig accepts codex provider on reviewer roles
Legacy reviewer names without suffix (e.g. reviewer-clarity) are accepted when loading workflow state
go test ./internal/specworkflow/ -run TestTeam passes
constraints: Must preserve backward compatibility with existing workflow state files
Agent naming must follow reviewer-{lens}-{provider} pattern

tasks.task_name: Implement CodexRunner satisfying the AgentRunner interface
tasks.goal: CodexRunner.Run() invokes codex exec --full-auto with prompt via stdin, --output-schema for structured output, --output-last-message for output capture, and returns AgentResult with exitCode, durationMS, and costUSD=0.

outputs.name: agent_result
outputs.constraints: costUSD always 0, exitCode from process, durationMS measured

outputs.name: output_file
outputs.constraints: valid ReviewerOutput or HoldoutOutput JSON when exitCode=0

acceptance: CodexRunner implements the AgentRunner interface
Run() invokes codex exec --full-auto -m <model> --output-schema <schema> --output-last-message <output> --cd <workspace> --ephemeral - with prompt on stdin
The prompt is delivered via stdin (not CLI argument) to avoid ARG_MAX limits
A temporary JSON schema file is created before invocation and cleaned up after
--output-schema flag points to the temp schema file
costUSD is always 0 regardless of outcome
durationMS reflects actual process execution time
Process exceeding timeout receives SIGTERM followed by SIGKILL after 2 seconds
Empty prompt returns an error without invoking codex
Empty output_path returns an error without invoking codex
go test ./internal/specworkflow/ -run TestCodexRunner passes
constraints: Must satisfy same AgentRunner interface as ClaudeRunner
Must handle process lifecycle: start, stdin write, timeout, signal, wait

tasks.task_name: Create ReviewerOutput JSON schema file for codex --output-schema
tasks.goal: A Go function returns the ReviewerOutput JSON schema as bytes, matching the existing ReviewerOutput struct definition, suitable for passing to codex via --output-schema.

outputs.name: schema_bytes
outputs.constraints: valid JSON Schema draft-07 or later

acceptance: ReviewerOutputSchema() returns valid JSON that parses as a JSON Schema
The schema defines findings as an array with required fields: id, description, severity, lens, recommendation
The schema defines lenses_applied as a required field
A valid ReviewerOutput JSON document validates against the schema
An invalid document (missing recommendation) fails validation against the schema

depends_on.reason: Reads existing type definitions but does not depend on other new tasks

constraints: Schema must match the existing ReviewerOutput struct exactly

tasks.task_name: Create HoldoutOutput JSON schema file for codex --output-schema
tasks.goal: A Go function returns the HoldoutOutput JSON schema as bytes, matching the existing HoldoutOutput struct definition, suitable for passing to codex via --output-schema for holdout generation.
acceptance: HoldoutOutputSchema() returns valid JSON that parses as a JSON Schema
The schema defines scenario_count, categories, and holdout_file as required fields
A valid HoldoutOutput JSON document validates against the schema
An invalid document (missing categories) fails validation against the schema

depends_on.reason: Reads existing type definitions but does not depend on other new tasks

constraints: Schema must match the existing HoldoutOutput struct exactly

tasks.task_name: Add codex CLI availability detection to orchestrator creation
tasks.goal: When the orchestrator is created with EnableCodexReviewers=true, it checks for codex in PATH via exec.LookPath; if missing, it logs a warning and disables codex runners; if present, it creates a CodexRunner instance.

inputs.name: config
inputs.constraints: EnableCodexReviewers may be true or false

outputs.name: codex_runner
outputs.constraints: nil when codex unavailable or disabled

outputs.name: warning_log
outputs.constraints: logged when codex enabled but missing

acceptance: When codex is not in PATH and EnableCodexReviewers=true, a warning is logged containing codex CLI not found
When codex is not in PATH, orchestrator.codexRunner is nil
When codex is in PATH and EnableCodexReviewers=true, orchestrator.codexRunner is non-nil
When EnableCodexReviewers=false, no PATH lookup is performed and no warning is logged
Orchestrator creation succeeds regardless of codex availability
constraints: Must not crash or fail orchestrator creation when codex is missing

tasks.task_name: Extend review dispatch to support dual-provider 8-reviewer parallel execution
tasks.goal: The review dispatch function launches 8 parallel reviewer goroutines (4 claude + 4 codex) when a codex runner is provided, writes output files with provider-disambiguated names, and applies the existing failure threshold logic to 8 reviewers.

outputs.name: dispatch_result
outputs.constraints: includes reduced_coverage flag and coverage_loss details

acceptance: When codex_runner is non-nil, 8 reviewer goroutines are launched concurrently
When codex_runner is nil, 4 claude-only reviewer goroutines are launched
Output files are named review-{letter}-claude-round-{N}.json and review-{letter}-codex-round-{N}.json
Failures <= 3 out of 8 result in reduced_coverage=true and the workflow proceeds
Failures >= 4 out of 8 result in an escalation error
Failures <= 1 out of 4 (claude-only) result in reduced_coverage=true and the workflow proceeds
All existing dispatch tests continue to pass (go test ./internal/specworkflow/ -run TestDispatch)
Reviewer agent names follow reviewer-{lens}-{provider} pattern
constraints: Must not change the AgentRunner interface
Must preserve backward compatibility for claude-only dispatch

tasks.task_name: Extend finding merge to preserve provider attribution in raised_by
tasks.goal: MergeReviewerOutputs handles 8 reviewer inputs, preserves provider-prefixed names in raised_by arrays, and the dedup_log records which providers contributed to each merged finding.

inputs.name: reviewer_outputs
inputs.constraints: 4 or 8 outputs with provider-prefixed reviewer names

outputs.name: merged_findings
outputs.constraints: raised_by contains provider-prefixed names, severity is max of duplicates

outputs.name: dedup_log
outputs.constraints: records source providers for each merge

acceptance: Merging findings from reviewer-clarity-claude (Sec3/AMB/MAJOR) and reviewer-clarity-codex (Sec3/AMB/CRITICAL) produces one finding with raised_by containing both names and severity CRITICAL
A finding only from reviewer-security-codex has raised_by containing only reviewer-security-codex
Findings on same section but different lenses are NOT deduplicated
Dedup log entries include provider info for both sides of each merge
Merge handles 8 inputs without error
Merge handles 4 inputs (claude-only) without error — backward compatible
Zero findings from a reviewer is accepted (empty array is valid)
All existing merge tests continue to pass (go test ./internal/specworkflow/ -run TestMerge)
constraints: Must not change the deduplication algorithm logic, only extend attribution

tasks.task_name: Implement dual-provider holdout generation dispatch and merge
tasks.goal: The holdout generation handler dispatches 2 parallel holdout agents (1 claude + 1 codex) when codex is available, merges their markdown outputs into a single holdouts-round-N.md with provider attribution, and degrades gracefully when codex fails.
acceptance: When codex_runner is non-nil, 2 holdout goroutines are launched concurrently (holdout-claude and holdout-codex)
When codex_runner is nil, only holdout-claude is launched
Output files follow naming: holdout-{provider}-round-{N}.json and holdouts-{provider}-round-{N}.md
Merged holdouts-round-{N}.md contains sections attributed to each provider
When codex holdout fails and claude succeeds, workflow proceeds with claude-only holdouts (no escalation)
When both holdout agents fail, the workflow escalates
No deduplication is applied to holdout scenarios across providers
When only one provider succeeds, merged file contains only that provider's scenarios with attribution note
constraints: Holdout failure is less critical than review failure — single provider is acceptable
Both agents use HoldoutTimeoutSeconds from config
non_goals: Changing the holdout prompt generation logic

tasks.task_name: Wire codex runner and config into orchestrator and API handler
tasks.goal: The orchestrator passes the codex runner to the review dispatch and holdout generation handlers, and the API handler passes codex config fields to the orchestrator constructor.

outputs.name: updated_orchestrator
outputs.constraints: codex runner plumbed to dispatch and holdout

acceptance: Orchestrator.handleReviewing passes codexRunner to the review dispatch function
Orchestrator.handleHoldoutGeneration passes codexRunner to the holdout dispatch function
WorkflowHandler passes EnableCodexReviewers, CodexModel, ReviewerTimeoutSeconds, and HoldoutTimeoutSeconds from request/config to the orchestrator
When codexRunner is nil, dispatch functions receive nil and operate in claude-only mode
Integration test: full orchestrator review phase with mock runners dispatches 8 reviewers when codex runner is non-nil
Integration test: full orchestrator review phase with nil codex runner dispatches 4 reviewers
constraints: Must not change existing API handler signatures in a breaking way

tasks.task_name: Add regression and backward compatibility tests for dual-provider feature
tasks.goal: Regression tests verify that claude-only dispatch (4 reviewers), 4-input merge, and 8-agent team configuration all work identically to pre-codex behavior.
acceptance: TestDispatch_BackwardCompat_ClaudeOnly passes: 4-reviewer dispatch with nil codex runner produces 4 output files
TestMerge_BackwardCompat_FourInputs passes: merge with exactly 4 claude-only inputs produces correct output
TestTeamConfig_BackwardCompat_NoCodex passes: team config with codex disabled returns 8 agents
All pre-existing tests in review_dispatch_test.go, merge_test.go, claude_runner_test.go, team_test.go continue to pass
go test ./internal/specworkflow/... passes with 0 failures
constraints: Must not modify existing test assertions, only add new test functions
